facts.fact: Moyna 16 岁的妹妹 Ellyn 几个月前 mage-testing 失败、几乎没有魔力；家中三个孩子里出了 Symon 和 Moyna 两个法师，三中取二已算公平
facts.anchor: who’d failed her own mage-testing several months ago

facts.fact: 这顿家宴是为 Symon 通过二年级考试庆祝；因 proctor geas，全家没有一个人问起 Moyna 的 Grand Exam
facts.anchor: None of her family asked about the Grand Exam.

facts.fact: 父母都是古典水法师，不是 artificer，因而未参与 artificer 罢工，且对它颇有微词；他们当年离开 Camar、学新语言、生三个孩子、培养出两个治疗师，指望带 Moyna 凯旋回乡
facts.anchor: Neither of them had trained as artificers, but as classical water-mages

facts.fact: Moyna 根本不想离开蓝城；她决心在被迫离开前尽量查清怪题与 Ysabel 之死
facts.anchor: I don’t want to leave the Blue City at all

facts.fact: Moyna 还脱口承认，她曾打算故意让整个 Grand Exam 不及格
facts.anchor: I was thinking of failing the whole Grand Exam.

facts.fact: Jehan 在与 Moyna 亲热中途停下，说自己在想别人——他恋爱了，对象是 Estiene，且已将近五年
facts.anchor: Muffled: “Almost five years. Probably. Not that it matters.”

facts.fact: Moyna 失口承认第一场考试就知道是 hare fever 却没说出来；Jehan 斥她背叛，说你明明知道是兔热病却不说
facts.anchor: You knew it was hare fever and you didn’t say it.

facts.fact: Sab Lavalle 闯进房门宣布 Estiene 因谋杀被捕；Moyna 与 Jehan 交换一个震惊的眼神后立刻抓衣服
facts.anchor: “Estiene’s been arrested for murder,” Sab said triumphantly
